name: io.github.Sendmux/sendmux-mcp
title: Sendmux MCP
description: Email inbox API for AI agents with Mailbox API, Management API, and Sending API tools.

environmentVariables.description: Product surfaces to expose, such as mailbox, sending, management, or a comma-separated combination.
environmentVariables.name: SENDMUX_MCP_SURFACES

environmentVariables.description: Mailbox API key for Mailbox API tools. Required when mailbox is selected.
environmentVariables.name: SENDMUX_MAILBOX_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Root key for Management API tools. Required when management is selected.
environmentVariables.name: SENDMUX_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mailbox-scoped key for Sending API tools. Required when sending is selected.
environmentVariables.name: SENDMUX_SENDING_API_KEY
